name: Historian Ruth

intro.text: About five thousand Boer prisoners were held on this island in 1900 and 1901. They built things, played cricket and wrote letters. Let me tell you about it on the way. Shall we?

win: That was brief. History usually isn't.
after: The Boer prisoners made carvings and furniture and even a small theatre. Some of what they built is still in use on the island.
